title.en: MALACAÑANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES TRANSFERRING THE PUBLIC ESTATE AUTHORITY FROM THE OFFICE OF THE PRESIDENT TO THE DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC WORKS AND HIGHWAYS
title.orig: MALACAÑANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES TRANSFERRING THE PUBLIC ESTATE AUTHORITY FROM THE OFFICE OF THE PRESIDENT TO THE DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC WORKS AND HIGHWAYS

text.en:
The Public Estate Authority is hereby transferred from the
Office of the President to the Department of Public Works and Highways.
All orders, issuances, rules and regulations, or parts thereof
which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified
accordingly.
Porta Hologram # 19322

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE, in the City of Manila this 21st day of April
of Or Lord, Two Thousand and Three.
By the President:
ALBERTO G. ROMULO
Executive Secretary
